Samurott

Water

Unova · Generation 5

Samurott is a Water-type Formidable Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 94.6 kg. It evolves from Dewott. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (108), with a base stat total of 528.
